description: Turn one keyword or page opportunity into an implementation-ready brief. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

current_rank.description: Known current organic search position, with 1 meaning first; omit when unknown rather than using zero. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. Optional; no client default.

include_competitor_outlines.description: Include sampled competitor heading outlines in the brief when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

keyword.description: Search keyword or phrase to analyze for this workflow. Type: String. Required.

language.description: Supported search language code, for example en for English. Type: String. Default: "en".

location.description: Supported geographic search-market name, for example United States; this is not a coordinate pair. Type: String. Default: "United States".

opportunity_type.description: Opportunity category to emphasize when constructing the brief. Type: String. Accepted values: "quick_win", "content_refresh", "ai_overview_opportunity", "featured_snippet_opportunity", "commercial_intent_opportunity", "lost_keyword_recovery", "competitor_gap". Optional; no client default.

page_url.description: Existing target page URL for the opportunity brief, if one already exists. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Optional; no client default.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Target domain, subdomain or absolute page URL to analyze; use a hostname or URL, not a business name. Type: String. Required.

name: agentseo_opportunities_brief
title: AgentSEO Opportunity Brief
